plates.quality_reason: Flow-first: a teach diagram, chart, counter or timeline is a £0 code graphic. No Flow mint.
plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, the 3-era timeline completes: 1664, 1906 & 1944–1955 (Replacing Descartes's bell-rope myth, Charles Sherrington discovers nociceptors, and Henry Knowles Beecher on the Anzio beachhead discovers stress analgesia and the placebo effect) · 19 November 1965 (Ronald Melzack and Patrick Wall at MIT publish the Gate Control Theory of Pain, proving fast A-beta touch fibres close a gate in the spinal cord's dorsal horn) · 1973 & 1975 (Candace Pert and Solomon Snyder at Johns Hopkins discover brain opioid receptors, and John Hughes and Hans Kosterlitz in Aberdeen isolate enkephalins and endorphins, the brain's own morphine).
